title: dryopteris microsora
intro: Dryopteris microsora, commonly known as the Mountain Fern, is a species of fern native to tropical Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Fern include reducing fever, alleviating respiratory issues, and treating various skin conditions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
